Emotion and feeling taxonomy (user-provi.summary: A user-provided descriptive taxonomy with six primary categories: Happy, Sad, Angry, Fearful, Bad, and Disgust. Each category groups related secondary and tertiary feelings with short descriptions, synonyms, and intensity ratings. This is a vocabulary/reference aid, not a validated diagnostic or emotion-reading tool. Do not infer a person's feelings from this taxonomy or treat physical cues as definitive.

Supplied image-triplet research data.summary: The supplied processed research records contain participant-keyed visual triplet trials: three ImageNet image paths, a selected image, response time, and trial labels such as within_class, between_class, and class_border. The source exports are repeated study snapshots and the processed pickle files contain participant records. This is visual similarity/grouping data, not emotion or conversational response data; participant-level records and identifiers are intentionally not copied into Lucy.

Supplied fMRI checkpoint.summary: The supplied checkpoint and YAML configuration describe a specialized multimodal fMRI response encoder (FmriEncoder with an eight-layer transformer), configured to combine text, image, and video features and train against brain-response values. It is a research prediction model, not a conversational language model and not an emotion classifier. Its architecture requires the matching research code, data, and modality encoders; it cannot be loaded directly as a Qwen/Ollama or GPT4All chat model.
